name: com.mira.stage
description: The Unity side of the mira-stage/1 protocol: connects to the Mira daemon, receives the character, scene and performance commands, plays the audio and face frames, and reports back. An engine-agnostic core (Runtime/*.cs, no UnityEngine, tested outside Unity); the Unity layer (Runtime/Unity: main thread, VRM, scene, audio) is added on the PC, see docs/UNITY.md in the repository.
